# World Language Reference

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/build_reference.py` from `sensoryforge describe --json`. Do not edit: change the code,
then run the command again. -->

What a `world:` file and a data-set file may name: the shapes, patterns, modulations, distributions and class kinds, each with its parameters, and the keys a world, class, layer, axis and split may carry. [Worlds and Data Sets](../user_guide/worlds.md) explains how a world is written; [World Engine Contract](world_contract.md) states what is guaranteed.

This page is generated from the world registries by `python scripts/build_reference.py`, so it lists what the loader accepts. Layered stimuli use the same shapes, patterns and modulations. A parameter table reads as on the [Component Reference](components.md#reading).

The world format is `sensoryforge-world/1` and the data-set format `sensoryforge-dataset/1`.

## File keys { #keys }

| Where | Keys |
|---|---|
| A world file | `channels`, `classes`, `defaults`, `description`, `fixed_draws`, `groups`, `held_out`, `modality`, `name`, `sessions`, `units` |
| A class (under `classes` or `held_out`) | `axes`, `channel`, `kind`, `layer`, `use`, `weight` |
| The `sessions` block of a world | `contact_fraction`, `duration_ms`, `gap_mean_ms`, `types` |
| A class's `layer` | `shape`, `pattern`, `motion`, `modulation`, `background`, `clamp_min` |
| An axis (a value under `axes`, `defaults` or a group) | `circular`, `dist`, `int`, `probes`, `range`, `same_as`, `stratify`, `value`, `values`, `weights` |
| The `kind` of a layer's `motion` | `none`, `linear`, `circular`, `path` |
| The `dist` of an axis with a `range` | `uniform`, `log_uniform` |

### Splits of a data set { #splits }

A split with no `kind:` takes the kind its name gives. Each kind takes the keys below besides `kind`, `repeats` and `noise_repeats`.

| Split | Kind |
|---|---|
| `train` | `declared` |
| `validation` | `declared` |
| `test` | `stratified` |
| `probes` | `probes` |
| `held_out` | `held_out` |
| `sessions` | `sessions` |
| `fixed` | `fixed` |

| Kind | Keys |
|---|---|
| `declared` | `n` |
| `fixed` | `draws` |
| `held_out` | `n`, `stratified` |
| `probes` | `bins`, `per_bin` |
| `sessions` | `duration_ms`, `n` |
| `stratified` | `stratified` |

## Shapes { #shape }

### `bar` { #shape-bar }

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amplitude` | float | `1` | 0 to 10000 |  | Peak value of one element. |
| `width_mm` | float | `0.3` | 0.001 to 100 | `mm` | Width across the bar (sigma for a gaussian profile). |
| `length_mm` | float | `0` | 0 to 1000 | `mm` | Length along the bar; 0 = an infinite edge. |
| `orientation_deg` | float | `0` | -360 to 360 | `deg` | Rotation. |
| `profile` | str | `"gaussian"` | one of `gaussian`, `flat` |  | Cross-section. |

### `curved_contact` { #shape-curved-contact }

A rigid indenter: its `amplitude` is the peak depth.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amplitude` | float | `1` | 0 to 10000 |  | peak indentation depth, in units (unit_mm mm each) |
| `radius_mm` | float | `20` | 0.1 to 1000 | `mm` | radius of curvature |
| `form` | str | `"sphere"` | one of `sphere`, `cylinder` |  | a sphere, or a cylinder whose axis lies along orientation_deg |
| `orientation_deg` | float | `0` | -3600 to 3600 | `deg` | cylinder axis direction (the bar convention: across = x sin t + y cos t) |
| `unit_mm` | float | `1` | 0.001 to 100 | `mm` | millimetres of indentation per unit of amplitude |

### `disc` { #shape-disc }

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amplitude` | float | `1` | 0 to 10000 |  | Peak value of one element. |
| `diameter_mm` | float | `1` | 0.001 to 100 | `mm` | Diameter of the flat top. |
| `edge_mm` | float | `0.1` | 0 to 10 | `mm` | Width of the soft edge (0 = hard). |

### `dot_array` { #shape-dot-array }

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amplitude` | float | `1` | 0 to 10000 |  | peak of one isolated dot |
| `sigma_mm` | float | `0.2` | 0.001 to 50 | `mm` | spread of one dot |
| `spacing_mm` | float | `2` | 0.01 to 1000 | `mm` | distance along a row |
| `row_spacing_mm` | float | `0` | 0 to 1000 | `mm` | distance between rows; 0 = spacing_mm (square) or spacing_mm \* sqrt(3) / 2 (hexagonal) |
| `orientation_deg` | float | `0` | -3600 to 3600 | `deg` | lattice rotation |
| `arrangement` | str | `"square"` | one of `square`, `hexagonal` |  | square, or hexagonal (every other row offset by half a spacing) |

### `gabor` { #shape-gabor }

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amplitude` | float | `1` | 0 to 10000 |  | Peak value of one element. |
| `sigma_mm` | float | `1` | 0.001 to 50 | `mm` | Width of the Gaussian window. |
| `wavelength_mm` | float | `1` | 0.001 to 100 | `mm` | Period of the stripes. |
| `orientation_deg` | float | `0` | -360 to 360 | `deg` | Rotation. |
| `phase_deg` | float | `0` | -360 to 360 | `deg` | Phase of the stripes. |
| `signed` *(advanced)* | bool | `false` |  |  | Zero-mean carrier with negative lobes (cos, or +/-1 for square) instead of the non-negative raised cosine. |

### `gaussian` { #shape-gaussian }

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amplitude` | float | `1` | 0 to 10000 |  | Peak value of one element. |
| `sigma_mm` | float | `0.5` | 0.001 to 50 | `mm` | Standard deviation of the bump. |

### `grating` { #shape-grating }

Drawn once over the plane, not at each pattern position.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amplitude` | float | `1` | 0 to 10000 |  | Peak value of one element. |
| `wavelength_mm` | float | `1` | 0.001 to 100 | `mm` | Period of the stripes. |
| `orientation_deg` | float | `0` | -360 to 360 | `deg` | Rotation. |
| `phase_deg` | float | `0` | -360 to 360 | `deg` | Phase of the stripes. |
| `profile` | str | `"sine"` | one of `sine`, `square` |  | Raised cosine or on/off. |
| `duty` *(advanced)* | float | `0.5` | 0.01 to 0.99 |  | Fraction of a period that is on (square profile). |
| `signed` *(advanced)* | bool | `false` |  |  | Zero-mean carrier with negative lobes (cos, or +/-1 for square) instead of the non-negative raised cosine. |

### `self_affine` { #shape-self-affine }

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amplitude` | float | `1` | 0 to 10000 |  | RMS of the surface is amplitude / sqrt(2), like a unit-peak sinusoid |
| `hurst` | float | `0.8` | 0 to 1 |  | Hurst exponent H |
| `rolloff_mm` | float | `2` | 0.01 to 1000 | `mm` | wavelength of the roll-off wavenumber q0 = 2 pi / rolloff_mm |
| `cutoff_mm` | float | `0.3` | 0.001 to 100 | `mm` | no power above q1 = 2 pi / cutoff_mm |
| `components` | int | `256` | 16 to 4096 |  | number of cosines in the synthesis |
| `seed` | int | `0` | 0 to 16777215 |  | the surface's own seed (integers stay exact in float32) |

### `step_edge` { #shape-step-edge }

A rigid indenter: its `amplitude` is the peak depth.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amplitude` | float | `1` | 0 to 10000 |  | depth of the plate's indentation, in units (unit_mm mm each) |
| `shoulder_radius_mm` | float | `2` | 0 to 1000 | `mm` | radius of the rounded shoulder (0 = a sharp step) |
| `orientation_deg` | float | `0` | -3600 to 3600 | `deg` | edge direction (the bar convention: across = x sin t + y cos t); the plate lies where across &lt;= 0 |
| `unit_mm` | float | `1` | 0.001 to 100 | `mm` | millimetres of indentation per unit of amplitude |

## Patterns { #pattern }

### `braille` { #pattern-braille }

`x_mm` and `y_mm` place the pattern.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | str | `"h"` |  |  | Letters a-z and spaces. |
| `dot_spacing_mm` | float | `2.5` | 0.1 to 100 | `mm` | Dot pitch within a cell. |
| `cell_spacing_mm` | float | `6` | 0.1 to 100 | `mm` | Distance between cell centres. |
| `x_mm` | float | `0` | -1000 to 1000 | `mm` | Centre of the first cell. |
| `y_mm` | float | `0` | -1000 to 1000 | `mm` | Centre of the first cell. |
| `dots` | str | `""` |  |  | Cells by dot number, e.g. '125 14'; when set it replaces text. A '/' starts a new line (in text too). |
| `line_spacing_mm` | float | `10` | 0.1 to 1000 | `mm` | Distance between lines (line L sits at y - L \* spacing). |

### `grid` { #pattern-grid }

`x_mm` and `y_mm` place the pattern.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rows` | int | `3` | 1 to 1000 |  | Rows (along y, first row on top). |
| `cols` | int | `2` | 1 to 1000 |  | Columns (along x, first column on the left). |
| `spacing_mm` | float | `2.5` | 0 to 1000 | `mm` | Distance between columns. |
| `row_spacing_mm` | float | `0` | 0 to 1000 | `mm` | Distance between rows; 0 = same as spacing_mm. |
| `x_mm` | float | `0` | -1000 to 1000 | `mm` | Centre of the grid. |
| `y_mm` | float | `0` | -1000 to 1000 | `mm` | Centre of the grid. |
| `mask` | str | `""` |  |  | Which cells are on, row by row: '1'/'0' (spaces ignored); empty = all on. |

### `list` { #pattern-list }

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `positions` | float | `[[0, 0]]` |  |  | [[x, y], ...] in mm. |
| `amplitudes` | float | `[]` |  |  | Optional scale per position (default 1). |

### `random` { #pattern-random }

`x_mm` and `y_mm` place the pattern.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | int | `30` | 1 to 100000 |  | How many elements. |
| `width_mm` | float | `10` | 0 to 10000 | `mm` | Width of the region. |
| `height_mm` | float | `10` | 0 to 10000 | `mm` | Height of the region. |
| `x_mm` | float | `0` | -1000 to 1000 | `mm` | Centre of the region. |
| `y_mm` | float | `0` | -1000 to 1000 | `mm` | Centre of the region. |
| `min_distance_mm` | float | `0` | 0 to 1000 | `mm` | No two elements closer than this (as far as the region allows). |
| `amplitude_jitter` | float | `0` | 0 to 1 |  | Each element's amplitude is scaled by 1 - jitter \* U(0, 1). |
| `seed` | int | `0` | 0 to 2147483647 |  | Random seed (same seed, same pattern). |

### `single` { #pattern-single }

`x_mm` and `y_mm` place the pattern.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x_mm` | float | `0` | -1000 to 1000 | `mm` | Position. |
| `y_mm` | float | `0` | -1000 to 1000 | `mm` | Position. |

## Modulations { #modulation }

### `none` { #modulation-none }

It takes no parameters.

### `pulses` { #modulation-pulses }

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rate_hz` | float | `5` | 0.001 to 10000 | `Hz` | Taps per second. |
| `duty` | float | `0.5` | 0.01 to 0.99 |  | Fraction of each period pressed. |
| `edge_ms` | float | `0` | 0 to 10000 | `ms` | Rise and fall of each tap (0 = step). |
| `depth` | float | `1` | 0 to 1 |  | 0 = no taps, 1 = lift fully between taps. |

### `sine` { #modulation-sine }

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `frequency_hz` | float | `10` | 0.001 to 10000 | `Hz` | Vibration frequency. |
| `depth` | float | `1` | 0 to 1 |  | 0 = none, 1 = from zero to peak. |
| `phase_deg` | float | `0` | -360 to 360 | `deg` | Phase at each touch (0 = peak). |

## Distributions { #distribution }

### `biased_direction` { #distribution-biased-direction }

Angles (degrees, in [0, 360)) of an anisotropic Gaussian velocity.

A quantile function: an axis that uses it can be stratified into equal-probability bins.

It declares bounds, a closed interval holding every number it draws, which the loader checks against the field the axis binds.

### `braille_cells` { #distribution-braille-cells }

It has a finite support, which stratifying needs.

### `letter_text` { #distribution-letter-text }

Text drawn letter by letter: `cells` letters on each of `lines` lines.

It has a finite support, which stratifying needs.
